projects.title: Lumsoo
projects.blurb: A luxury Korean beauty store built from nothing: a custom WooCommerce theme, a 600+ product catalogue pulled and rebuilt from a supplier API, a brand directory, and editorial category art. Live and selling in Bangladesh.

projects.title: Lumsoo Auto-Poster
projects.blurb: A WordPress plugin that schedules and publishes 100+ product posters to Facebook and Instagram on its own. Facebook uses native Graph API scheduling; Instagram has no scheduling API, so a cron worker publishes each post at its exact slot.

projects.title: Utopia
projects.blurb: A desktop control panel for running the whole store from one window — orders, stock and supplier steps in a single Electron app. Deliberately scoped down to what the data actually justified instead of the enterprise version I first sketched.
